[[File:H9_Turbolasers_SWArmada.png|thumb|right|300px|H9 turbolaser]]
The '''H9 turbolaser''' was a shipboard emplacement weapon produced by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]].

H9 [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] in single- and dual-emplacement turrets served as the primary armament on the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]]. They were also mounted in a dual emplacement on the rear of the [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttle]].
